title: An overview of DREAD, LINDDUN and attack trees

videos.script: STRIDE and PASTA are not the only methods with a name. Three more come up often enough that you need to know what they are for, and one of them, what it is not for. {{three}} DREAD gives a threat a score out of ten. Two careful people score the same threat and get different numbers. You will see by how much. {{dread}} LINDDUN asks about privacy. Not whether an attacker can read the data, but whether the system should be holding it at all, and whether the patient knows. {{linddun}} And attack trees draw one goal and every way to reach it. Then you can ask a very practical question. If we buy this control, what does the cheapest path cost now? {{trees}} By the end, you will know which of the three to reach for, and which one to leave on the shelf. {{choose}}
